scope: I froze the first two authors-matched layers (0 and 2), all eight role spaces, prompt split only. Later fits are outside this bounded comparison.
verdict: I found no fresh mechanical fit defect requiring interruption. These early held-out accuracies reproduce the independent H200 reference to within 0.1 percentage point; optimizer convergence remains unverified.
comparison_identity: I compare my new run with the archived independent H200 replication, not with an original paper-trained artifact.

recipe.input_cast: stored float16 to float32 before cuML
recipe.full_prompt_split: cuML train_test_split on role-filtered unique prompt_ix; test_size=.1; random_state=123

formulas.reference_accuracy: sum(count where role==pred) / sum(count), within each (layer_ix, role_space)
formulas.difference_percentage_points: 100 * (local log rounded accuracy - reference confusion-derived accuracy)
formulas.denominator: held-out labeled content-token rows for the corresponding role-space split
formulas.local_rounding: The local fit log retains three decimal places; rounding alone contributes up to 0.05 percentage point of uncertainty.

warning_interpretation: In cuML branch-25.08, line-search code1 is LS_INVALID_STEP_MIN. The solver could not accept the tiny step and stopped with OPT_LS_FAILED, restoring the previous valid coefficients when required. This is not a demonstrated convergence success, nor proof of label or activation corruption.
material_uncertainty: Matching held-out accuracy does not establish coefficient equality, probability calibration, optimality, or later-layer/Appendix E success. No native full-run probe pickle existed at capture, so n_iter_ and solver objective were not inspected.
nondefect_warning: The PyTorch read-only NumPy warning originates from a read-only activation memmap; this trainer indexes and casts it without in-place mutation. I found no write that would trigger the stated undefined behavior.
cheap_post_save_diagnostic: After the existing native pickle is saved, inspect clf=probe["probe"].named_steps["clf"], clf.n_iter_, clf.solver_model.num_iters, clf.solver_model.objective, clf.get_params(), finite coef_/intercept_, and class order. Associate those fields with this existing fit log. Do not fit again or load/forward a language model. n_iter_ <5000 alone does not establish convergence.
